prompt.en: Rain changes a voluntary creative afternoon indoors. What would you most like to choose?
prompt.zh: 下雨让自愿创作下午改到室内，你最想选什么？

label.en: A personally meaningful little activity, even if it is quieter than the first plan.
label.zh: 一个对自己有意义的小活动，即使比原计划安静。

label.en: A moment to consider the practical change before making another commitment.
label.zh: 先留一刻想清实际变化，再作另一个承诺。

label.en: A simple hands-on fix that lets the group use the room comfortably.
label.zh: 一个简单动手小修，让房间好用。

label.en: A few playful details that make the changed afternoon feel like an occasion.
label.zh: 一些趣味细节，让改后的下午也有活动感。

prompt.en: Friends propose a new indoor plan faster than you can consider it. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 朋友提新室内计划，比自己考虑还快，什么最吸引你？

label.en: Ask for a short pause to understand what the plan involves before agreeing.
label.zh: 要求短暂停，弄清计划涉及什么再同意。

label.en: Try setting up the basic materials so the practical possibilities are visible.
label.zh: 试着摆基本材料，让实际可能看得见。

label.en: Imagine a small enjoyable reveal that could make this version feel special.
label.zh: 想个令人愉快的小揭幕，让这版特别。

label.en: Say clearly which parts I am willing to join and which I would rather skip.
label.zh: 说清愿加入哪部分、想跳过哪部分。

prompt.en: A familiar craft tool needs an ordinary, harmless adjustment. What would you enjoy?
prompt.zh: 熟悉手作工具需一项普通无害调整，你喜欢什么？

label.en: Work on the little fix because trying the mechanism is enjoyable itself.
label.zh: 动手小修，因为试机关本身就好玩。

label.en: Use the fix as a chance to add a playful decorative detail.
label.zh: 借小修加一处趣味装饰。

label.en: Check what changes the owner actually wants made to their tool.
label.zh: 核主人实际想改工具什么。

label.en: Turn the attempt into an optional lighthearted challenge we can share.
label.zh: 把尝试变成可选轻松挑战，一起玩。

prompt.en: Your friends want the modest afternoon to feel memorable. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 朋友想让不大的下午活动值得记住，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Plan a few enjoyable details that suit the people who actually want them.
label.zh: 设计几项适合真正想要者的愉快细节。

label.en: Make sure nobody is expected to accept a surprise they dislike.
label.zh: 不让人被期待接受不喜欢的惊喜。

label.en: Offer a playful shared activity with a comfortable way to watch instead.
label.zh: 给一个共同趣味活动，也容舒服旁观。

label.en: Ask what would make each person comfortable enough to enjoy the afternoon.
label.zh: 问怎样让各人舒服享受下午。

prompt.en: Someone assumes you will take a role you did not agree to. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 有人默认自己会接一个没同意的角色，你更愿意怎么做？

label.en: Clarify what I actually choose to offer and leave the rest open for discussion.
label.zh: 说清自己实际选择提供什么，其他再讨论。

label.en: Suggest a lighthearted shared task rather than assigning it silently to one person.
label.zh: 建议一起轻松做，不默默派给一个人。

label.en: Ask what help is wanted and what each person can comfortably give.
label.zh: 问需要什么帮助、各人舒服能给什么。

label.en: Choose the part that feels personally worthwhile to me.
label.zh: 选对自己有意义的那部分。

prompt.en: The afternoon has a little spare time. What sounds most enjoyable?
prompt.zh: 下午多一点空闲，什么最好玩？

label.en: A gentle, optional challenge where the shared laughter matters more than winning.
label.zh: 一个温和可选挑战，共同笑声比赢更重要。

label.en: A conversation about what would help everyone enjoy the rest of the session.
label.zh: 聊聊什么让各人更享受剩余活动。

label.en: A quiet choice that lets me spend time on something I actually care about.
label.zh: 一个安静选择，把时间留给真在意的事。

label.en: A pause to decide whether adding anything more would improve the afternoon.
label.zh: 暂停想再加内容是否真改善下午。

prompt.en: A friend seems uncertain about joining the changed plan. What would you most like to do?
prompt.zh: 朋友对改后计划犹豫，你最想怎样做？

label.en: Ask what they would find helpful without deciding their needs for them.
label.zh: 问什么有帮助，不替对方决定需要。

label.en: Share what I personally hope to get from the activity and invite their preference.
label.zh: 说自己希望从活动得到什么，再邀其偏好。

label.en: Give them time to consider the details before they answer.
label.zh: 给时间考虑细节再回答。

label.en: Show a simple practical option they can try without committing to the whole plan.
label.zh: 展示可先试的简单实际选项，不必承诺全计划。

prompt.en: There are several equally acceptable ways to spend the rainy afternoon. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 雨天下午有几种同样可行玩法，你更愿意怎样选？

label.en: Choose the one that feels meaningful to me rather than the most impressive on paper.
label.zh: 选对自己有意义的，不选纸面最厉害的。

label.en: Consider the commitments each option creates before making a choice.
label.zh: 选择前想每项带来什么承诺。

label.en: Try a little hands-on sample to discover which activity is satisfying.
label.zh: 动手试个小样，看看哪项满足。

label.en: Imagine how a few thoughtful details could make one option especially enjoyable.
label.zh: 想怎样用细节让某项特别愉快。

prompt.en: A new craft idea would require more time than the group first planned. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 新手作点子需比原计划多花时间，什么最吸引你？

label.en: Take a moment to understand the extra commitment and decide whether to accept it.
label.zh: 先懂额外承诺，再决定接不接受。

label.en: Test a small working version before guessing how much effort it needs.
label.zh: 先试小工作版，别猜需要多少投入。

label.en: Plan a smaller enjoyable version that still has a sense of occasion.
label.zh: 设计小些仍有活动感的愉快版本。

label.en: State a comfortable limit on my own part of the extra work.
label.zh: 说自己额外工作舒服的上限。

prompt.en: Your friends are making a simple prop for their own original story. What would you enjoy?
prompt.zh: 朋友给自己的原创故事做简单道具，你喜欢什么？

label.en: Experiment with the ordinary parts and enjoy discovering a workable arrangement.
label.zh: 试普通部件，享受发现可行组合。

label.en: Add a delightful little feature that makes the prop fun to present.
label.zh: 加一项愉快小功能，让展示道具好玩。

label.en: Ask the maker which parts they want left as they are.
label.zh: 问制作者哪些想保持原样。

label.en: Make the demonstration into a gentle game people may freely join.
label.zh: 把演示变成可自由加入的温和游戏。

prompt.en: The group considers adding a surprise to a voluntary gathering. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 小组想给自愿聚会加个惊喜，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Design the pleasant detail around preferences people have actually shared.
label.zh: 按人们实际分享过的喜好，设计愉快细节。

label.en: Keep an easy way to decline or change the surprise.
label.zh: 留容易拒绝、改惊喜的办法。

label.en: Choose a playful reveal that people can enjoy without performing excitement.
label.zh: 选有趣揭幕，不要求人表演兴奋。

label.en: Ask what would make the event comfortable for the participants.
label.zh: 问怎样让参与者舒服。

prompt.en: You like the activity but want a smaller role than others suggest. What attracts you?
prompt.zh: 喜欢活动，却想比别人建议接更小角色，什么吸引你？

label.en: Name the part I want and the point where my contribution ends.
label.zh: 说想做哪部分、贡献到哪结束。

label.en: Find a shared playful version that spreads the effort voluntarily.
label.zh: 找自愿分担投入的共同趣味版。

label.en: Ask what support would make a smaller contribution workable for everyone.
label.zh: 问怎样支持，让小贡献对大家可行。

label.en: Keep the piece that is personally meaningful instead of accepting the whole role.
label.zh: 留对自己有意义的一块，不接全角色。

prompt.en: Friends want a little competition after making their crafts. What would you enjoy?
prompt.zh: 手作后朋友想来点小竞赛，你喜欢什么？

label.en: A friendly challenge people can laugh about without ranking the participants.
label.zh: 友好挑战，让人一起笑，不排名参与者。

label.en: A check that everyone can choose a comfortable way to join or observe.
label.zh: 核每人都能选舒服参与或旁观。

label.en: The activity I would genuinely enjoy even without an audience.
label.zh: 即使没人看也真享受的活动。

label.en: A moment to consider whether another game fits the time and energy available.
label.zh: 先想另一游戏是否合剩余时间、精力。

prompt.en: One person’s plan for the afternoon no longer fits the changed room. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 一人的下午计划不再适合改后的房间，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Ask what they need now and help discuss options they genuinely want.
label.zh: 问现在需要什么，帮聊真正想要的选项。

label.en: Share which part of the activity still feels worthwhile to me.
label.zh: 说自己仍觉得哪部分值得。

label.en: Pause before offering a solution so the actual change is clear.
label.zh: 先看清实际变化，再给解法。

label.en: Try a straightforward practical adjustment to the room or materials.
label.zh: 试一个直截了当的房间、材料调整。

prompt.en: The group can keep one modest part of its original outdoor plan indoors. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 原室外计划有一小部分能留到室内，你更愿意选什么？

label.en: The part that carries a personal meaning I still want to enjoy.
label.zh: 仍想享受、有个人意义的部分。

label.en: The part whose commitments we have had time to understand and accept.
label.zh: 已经有时间理解、接受承诺的部分。

label.en: The part we can make work with a little practical tinkering.
label.zh: 稍作实际修整就能运作的部分。

label.en: The part that can become a thoughtfully prepared little celebration.
label.zh: 能成为用心准备小庆祝的部分。

prompt.en: Someone asks for your answer to a new shared project immediately. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 有人要立刻回答新共同项目，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Ask for enough time to consider what I would be agreeing to.
label.zh: 要求足够时间，想自己到底同意什么。

label.en: Try one small practical step before promising the finished project.
label.zh: 承诺全项目之前，先试一个小实际步骤。

label.en: Imagine a compact enjoyable version before deciding how much to plan.
label.zh: 先想紧凑愉快版，再决定计划多少。

label.en: Say clearly which part I can choose now and which remains undecided.
label.zh: 说清哪部分现在能选、哪部分未定。

prompt.en: A homemade object is almost working, with one harmless loose connection. What would you enjoy?
prompt.zh: 自制物件快能用了，还松一处无害接点，你喜欢什么？

label.en: Try a simple adjustment and see how the mechanism responds.
label.zh: 试简单调整，看看机关回应。

label.en: Turn the working version into a pleasant little presentation.
label.zh: 把能用版本变成愉快小展示。

label.en: Check whether the owner wants the connection changed or left flexible.
label.zh: 核主人想改接点，还是留弹性。

label.en: Share an optional playful attempt at solving it together.
label.zh: 一起作可选趣味尝试。

prompt.en: The group is deciding which little event details matter. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 小组在决定活动哪些小细节重要，什么最吸引你？

label.en: A few personal touches that make a modest gathering feel deliberately prepared.
label.zh: 少数个人化点缀，让小聚会有用心准备感。

label.en: A clear limit so the details do not create work people never accepted.
label.zh: 清楚上限，不让细节变成没接过的工作。

label.en: A playful moment people can share without a demanding performance.
label.zh: 一个不要求费力表演的共同趣味时刻。

label.en: A practical check on what participants would find helpful or comfortable.
label.zh: 实际核参与者觉得什么有用、舒服。

prompt.en: A friend offers to decide every detail of your part for you. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 朋友提议替自己决定所有细节，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Keep the choices I want to make myself and ask for only the help I welcome.
label.zh: 保留自己想作的选择，只请愿意接的帮助。

label.en: Suggest a shared playful task where each person can choose their part.
label.zh: 提共同趣味任务，各人自选部分。

label.en: Discuss what support would help without taking over anyone’s decision.
label.zh: 聊怎样支持，又不接管谁的决定。

label.en: Return to the part of the afternoon that feels personally worthwhile.
label.zh: 回到下午对自己有意义的部分。

prompt.en: The crafts are finished and friends want to mark the moment. What would you enjoy?
prompt.zh: 手作完工，朋友想留个时刻，你喜欢什么？

label.en: A gentle shared game or laugh that lets everyone join in their own way.
label.zh: 一个温和共同游戏、笑声，各人按自己方式加入。

label.en: A conversation that recognises what people need before wrapping up.
label.zh: 收尾前聊聊，看见各人需要。

label.en: A quiet moment with the piece that means something to me.
label.zh: 与对自己有意义作品安静相处一刻。

label.en: A pause to decide whether more activity is wanted or the session is complete.
label.zh: 暂停决定还想不想加活动，或已完成。

prompt.en: The indoor afternoon is ending with one person unsure what comes next. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 室内下午将结束，一人不确定接着怎样，你更愿意做什么？

label.en: Ask what would be useful and agree help that both people freely choose.
label.zh: 问什么有用，约双方都自选的帮助。

label.en: Say which part I personally want to keep doing another time.
label.zh: 说自己另一天还想继续哪部分。

label.en: Leave time to consider a next commitment rather than promising immediately.
label.zh: 留时间考虑下个承诺，不立刻答应。

label.en: Make a simple practical note or adjustment that helps the next session start.
label.zh: 做个简单实际记录、调整，让下次好开始。
